about: Portraits the game will not cast for someone of its own making, and why: a likeness should be someone who could be them, in a world with its own gods, and an excellent page in type is better than a misleading painting. An author who names a painting for someone (Likeness "x" in Kyr) still has it. Read by src/paintings/likeness.ts.
